nodes.label: Colonial Legal Order
nodes.evidence_status: Institutional claims and dates are verified, including corrections to provincial constabulary structure and religious proportions.
nodes.rationale: Dublin Castle, unelected Grand Juries, gentry magistrates, unequal courts, and transitional policing made formal procedure an instrument of Protestant landed power.

nodes.label: Land, Tithe, and Local Coercion
nodes.rationale: Tithe proctors, landlords, agents, bailiffs, ejectment, and Catholic disabilities made authority a daily economic pressure rather than an abstract state.
